comment:
The manual names the five controls and says nothing about what any of them does numerically. From the code: Transient is ±6dB driven by the difference between a 0.5ms and a 15ms envelope (Master.cpp:186-199); Glue moves the threshold from -2dB to -12dB and the ratio from 1 to 4 with a 3dB soft knee, blends parallel by the same amount, adds up to 1.5dB of makeup and up to 12% tanh saturation (Master.cpp:203-244); Width splits the side signal at 140Hz and expands only the upper part above unity (Master.cpp:142, 245-266); Limit sets a ceiling of 1.20 down to 0.75 in the normalised domain, which is 6V down to 3.75V, with instant attack and a 120ms release (Master.cpp:275-297).

Audio is clamped to ±4 in the internal domain on the way in and again on the way out (Master.cpp:114-119, 302-303), so the outputs can reach ±20V. The clip lamp lights above ±5V and holds for a quarter of a second (Master.cpp:312-317).
